description.value: Spilt Milk is Revelstoke's Australian-inspired specialty coffee roaster and café, roasting every batch in-house on a low-emission Loring S15 Falcon for clean, consistent results. The café on 2nd Street East serves specialty coffee and food in a deliberately community-focused space that explicitly welcomes cyclists passing through town. The business rebranded from Dose Coffee after a legal name conflict, drawing its new identity from skate culture and a philosophy of resilience.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active specialty café and coffee roastery at 101 2nd St E, Revelstoke, BC, consistent with the OSM address. The about page explicitly mentions welcoming cyclists ('coming off a ride'), and the café page plus site navigation confirm online/order-ahead takeout. OSM tags for toilets=yes and internet_access=yes could not be independently confirmed from the website content, so those remain null per the evidence-only rule; no bike parking details appear anywhere in the website text.
concerns: OSM name is 'Spilt Milk' but the website title uses 'Spilt Milk Coffee Roasters' — the OSM short form may underrepresent the brand.
No phone number present in OSM or on the website contact page.
OSM toilets=yes and internet_access=yes (customers) could not be confirmed from website content; these amenities remain unverified.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active specialty café and roastery in Revelstoke with food service and online ordering; the about page explicitly mentions welcoming cyclists, making it a strong fit for a touring cyclist directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Business was formerly known as 'Dose Coffee' before a legal name conflict prompted the rebrand to Spilt Milk. The roastery operates from a separate location on Big Eddy Road, Revelstoke.
